subject: Request: Cross-region starter bundle exception & onboarding rebate for Pathway Health
messages:
From: Alex Li <alex.li@pathway.health>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Regional throughput & starter pricing request

Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. A few follow-ups from our SRE and procurement teams: Pathway needs predictable inference throughput in both US-WEST and EU-CENTRAL for our initial pilot. We expect spiky traffic during hours and want a short onboarding window (90 days) with the ability to burst into a regional pool.

High level asks:
- Lower unit pricing for the first 3 months to account for pilot overheads.
- A small committed capacity guarantee (monthly floor) across two geozones; credits for overshoot into the shared burst pool.
- Standard SOC2 evidence and backup encryption docs (we already have NDA).

Can you share a starter bundle + any one-time onboarding rebate you can make available?

Cheers,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
Pathway Health

Attachments: Pathway_Initial_Request.pdf (application & SRE notes)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Alex Li <alex.li@pathway.health>
Cc: kyle.salesops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional throughput & starter pricing request

Alex —

Appreciate the clear asks. I’ve sketched a starter bundle that combines a modest 3-month onboarding rebate plus a dual-region commitment floor and burst pool rules (see attached). High-level proposal:

- 3-month onboarding rebate: 35% off per-token unit price for the first 90 days (applied to committed floor usage only).
- Monthly committed floor: 10M tokens aggregated across US-WEST + EU-CENTRAL.
- Burst pool: additional consumption billed at on-demand rate; we’ll reserve capacity to enable regional bursts up to 2x committed per region (subject to availability).
- One-time onboarding credit: $12,000 to offset integration work (applied to first invoice).

I’m looped in with our procurement and finance teams to confirm accounting treatment. I’ll run this up internally for a formal exception if needed — can you confirm the target contract length (12 vs 24 months) and whether pathfinder customers require stricter SLA?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-bundle-pricing-v2.xlsx (pricing sketch)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Pathway Health — ask for cross-region starter rebate & one-time credit (need exec signoff)

Team —

Pathway (deal PW-2027-0427) is requesting a cross-region starter bundle with a 35% onboarding rebate (90 days) + $12k one-time credit. They want the monthly floor shared across US-WEST and EU-CENTRAL and the ability to burst into a shared regional pool. They’re leaning towards a 12-month contract but will consider 24 months for better pricing.

Why I think we should approve a limited exception:
- Strategic value: healthcare prospect with potential to expand to 5 pilot sites by Q4.
- Predictable runway: the committed floor (10M tokens/mo) gives us a minimum revenue floor and helps capacity planning.
- Competitive pressure: their procurement has competing offers with deeper short-term discounts but less stable inference SLAs.

Proposed guardrails if we approve:
- Limit rebate to committed floor only; bursts billed at on-demand.
- Rebate auto-terminates after 90 days and cannot be reissued.
- Attach a rollback clause: if month-over-month consumption < 40% of committed floor for two consecutive months after the rebate, the remaining onboarding credit is forfeited.

Quick numbers:
- List unit price (post-negotiation): $0.0008/token.
- Committed floor: 10M tokens/mo => $8,000/mo list => $24,000 over 3 months.
- 35% rebate on floor for first 3 months => discount ~$8,400.
- One-time credit: $12,000.
- Net first-quarter revenue (approx): $24,000 - $8,400 - $12,000 = $3,600 (we are effectively subsidizing onboarding to secure long-term ARR).

Needs: Marissa — can you sign off (VP/CFO level authorization) on the one-time credit + rebate framework? Karthik — any concerns on precedent or finance treatment? Grace — please confirm SOC2 doc drop and SRE onboarding timeline if approved.

Regards,
Jonas

Attachments: geo-usage-estimates-2027Q3.xlsx

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Pathway Health — ask for cross-region starter rebate & one-time credit (need exec signoff)

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear memo and the guardrails. A few notes from finance/legal:
- We should convert the $12k onboarding credit into a milestone credit (e.g., 50% on SRE onboarding completion, 50% after production cutover) to reduce churn risk.
- Precedent: large one-off credits tend to get cited by other reps; recommend marking this as "strategic pilot concession — non-repeatable" in the contract and internal deal notes.
- Accounting: This will push most of the first-quarter recognized revenue down; ensure RevOps flags the deal for correct ARR treatment.

If Marissa signs off on the milestone structure and non-repeatable label, finance is OK.

—Karthik

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Pathway Health — ask for cross-region starter rebate & one-time credit (need exec signoff)

Thanks for the thorough notes. I’ve reviewed the numbers and risk profile. Approve on the following conditions:

1) Convert the $12k onboarding credit to milestone-based credits as Karthik recommended (50/50).
2) Rebate limited strictly to committed floor for the first 90 days and documented as a "one-time strategic pilot concession — non-repeatable" in the deal record and contract.
3) Include a 30-day post-rebate performance review clause; if usage < 50% of committed floor for both months after rebate period ends, we reserve the right to charge a catch-up fee (calculated at on-demand rates).

Jonas — proceed to formalize the terms in the SOW and route to legal for the non-repeatable concession language. Grace — please prepare the SOC2 artifact bundle and a 2-week onboarding checklist to support the milestone release. Karthik — coordinate RevOps to ensure correct revenue recognition mapping.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
